No DOM, react-router-dom, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported. The page has no i18n on the web original, so strings are kept as literals.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck`; `npm run lint -- --quiet`; `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles`. Companion __tests__/StatusApiDocsPageParity.test.tsx mounts the page and asserts: the title 'Status API' + subtitle render, all six /api/v1/status* endpoint paths render, the back link (status-api-back-link) calls onNavigate('/system-status'), and the per-endpoint 'Example response' disclosure is collapsed by default and reveals the JSON payload (e.g. 'operational') after the toggle is pressed.
